comment: Native Hermes cron job fields, from Hermes ed1afb0. `routine` fields the app reads as routine settings and checks itself; `status` fields Hermes's scheduler writes as bookkeeping (claims, dispatch, completions, outcomes) and never change what a job does. Any other field that is set, such as monitor_script, workdir, base_url, interpreter, timezone or a field a later Hermes adds, can change how a job runs. tests/hermes_delegation_test.py runs a real job through ed1afb0's scheduler and checks every field it ends up with is listed here.
